question: How do I apply for deferment of study and what is the deadline?
reference_facts: Applications for deferment of study must be submitted by week four (4) of the semester via the student portal. Medical deferment requires an official hospital medical certificate.

question: Bagaimanakah cara memohon penangguhan pengajian atas sebab kesihatan?
reference_facts: Pelajar perlu mengemukakan permohonan penangguhan pengajian selewat-lewatnya minggu keempat (4) semester beserta sijil perubatan rasmi daripada hospital.

question: When is the course registration add and drop window open?
reference_facts: Students may add or drop courses during the first two (2) weeks of the semester.

question: Apakah waktu operasi perpustakaan utama universiti?
reference_facts: Perpustakaan Utama dibuka setiap hari Isnin hingga Jumaat dari jam 8:00 pagi hingga 10:00 malam.

question: Who is eligible to apply for on-campus hostel accommodation?
reference_facts: On-campus hostel accommodation (Kolej Kediaman dan Asrama) is open to all first-year undergraduate students.
